new_player_tooltip: The amount of users who entered the experience for the first time within the selected statistical time range (including logged-in users and guest users).
total_player_tooltip: The total amount of users who have accessed and played the experience until the last day of the selected time period (including both logged-in users and guest users).
active_player_tooltip: The amount of unique users who have accessed the experience within the selected statistical time range (including both logged-in users and guest users).
like_tooltip: The number of times the experience has been liked by users within the selected statistical time range.
collect_tooltip: The number of times the experience has been favorited by users within the selected statistical time range.
comment_tooltip: The number of times the experience has been commented by users within the selected statistical time range.
view_count_toolip: The total amount of times the experience details page has been viewed by users within the selected statistical time range.
play_count_toolip: The total amount of times users have played your experience within the selected statistical time range.
play_duration_toolip: The total amount of time that users have spent in your experience within the selected statistical time range.
per_duration_toolip: The average amount of time that users have spent in your experience within the selected statistical time range.
name: Title
remain_analysis_tooltip_2: The amount of users who have visited the experience within the selected statistical time range (including both logged-in users and guest users).
remain_analysis_tooltip_4: The amount of users who come back and played again on the second day (Day 1), 8th day (Day 7), and 31st day (Day 30) after their first visit among the users who have accessed the experience within the selected statistical time range.
remain_analysis_tooltip_6: The percentage of users who come back and played again on the second day (Day 1), 8th day (Day 7), and 31st day (Day 30).
